import chars = "./charset.qui"
import format = "./formatter.qui"

class State(int pc, int position, int[] capture, bool[] splits)
class Success(int[] capture, int position)
class Engine(format.Instruction[] code, int[] subject, string flags, int groups, bool full, steps := 0, aborted := false)

bool consumes(const format.Instruction entry, const int[] subject, int position, string flags)
    if position == int(#subject)
        return false
    code := subject[position]
    if entry.kind == "CHAR"
        return chars.equal(code, entry.argument, flags)
    if entry.kind == "ANY"
        return flags.contains("s") or code != 10
    return chars.class_matches(code, entry.members, entry.negated, flags)

Success | none execute(Engine &engine, int pc, int position, const int[] capture, bool partial)
    stack := [State(pc, position, capture, array(#engine.code, fill = false))]
    while #stack != 0
        last := int(#stack) - 1
        state := stack[last]
        stack = stack[0:<last]
        while true
            engine.steps += 1
            if engine.steps > 200000
                engine.aborted = true
                return none
            entry := engine.code[state.pc]
            if entry.kind == "CHAR" or entry.kind == "ANY" or entry.kind == "CLASS"
                if not consumes(entry, engine.subject, state.position, engine.flags)
                    break
                state.position += 1
                state.pc += 1
                state.splits = array(#engine.code, fill = false)
            elif entry.kind == "SPLIT"
                if state.splits[state.pc]
                    break
                state.splits[state.pc] = true
                stack = stack.append(State(entry.second, state.position, state.capture, state.splits))
                state.pc = entry.argument
            elif entry.kind == "JMP"
                state.pc = entry.argument
            elif entry.kind == "SAVE"
                state.capture[entry.argument] = state.position
                state.pc += 1
            elif entry.kind == "ASSERT"
                if not chars.assertion(entry.mode, engine.subject, state.position, engine.flags)
                    break
                state.pc += 1
            elif entry.kind == "BACKREF"
                start := state.capture[2 * entry.argument]
                finish := state.capture[2 * entry.argument + 1]
                if start < 0 or finish < 0 or start > finish
                    break
                count := finish - start
                matches := state.position + count <= int(#engine.subject)
                if matches
                    for: index < count
                        if not chars.equal(engine.subject[state.position + index], engine.subject[start + index], engine.flags)
                            matches = false
                            break
                if not matches
                    break
                state.position += count
                state.pc += 1
                if count > 0
                    state.splits = array(#engine.code, fill = false)
            elif entry.kind == "LOOK"
                Success | none result := execute(&engine, state.pc + 1, state.position, state.capture, true)
                if engine.aborted
                    return none
                succeeded := false
                body := Success([], state.position)
                match result
                    Success found
                        succeeded = true
                        body = found
                    none
                        succeeded = false
                if entry.mode == "NOT"
                    if succeeded
                        break
                else
                    if not succeeded
                        break
                    state.capture = body.capture
                    if entry.mode == "ATOMIC"
                        if body.position > state.position
                            state.splits = array(#engine.code, fill = false)
                        state.position = body.position
                state.pc = entry.argument
            else
                if partial or not engine.full or state.position == int(#engine.subject)
                    return Success(state.capture, state.position)
                break
    return none

int[] | none search(Engine &engine, int start)
    first := if engine.full then 0 else start
    last := if engine.full then 0 else int(#engine.subject)
    for: first <= position <= last
        initial := array(nat(2 * engine.groups + 2), fill = -1)
        match execute(&engine, 0, position, initial, false)
            Success result
                return result.capture
            none
                if engine.aborted
                    return none
    return none

bool letter(int code)
    return 65 <= code <= 90 or 97 <= code <= 122

bool digit(int code)
    return 48 <= code <= 57

bool word(int code)
    return letter(code) or digit(code) or code == 95

int swap(int code)
    return if 97 <= code <= 122 then code - 32 elif 65 <= code <= 90 then code + 32 else code

bool equal(int first, int second, string flags)
    return first == second or (flags.contains("i") and letter(first) and swap(first) == second)

bool[] empty()
    return array(128, fill = false)

bool[] base(int code)
    lower := if 65 <= code <= 90 then code + 32 else code
    result := empty()
    for: character < 128
        member := if lower == 100 then digit(character) elif lower == 119 then word(character) else character == 9 or character == 10 or character == 11 or character == 12 or character == 13 or character == 32
        result[character] = if 65 <= code <= 90 then not member else member
    return result

bool class_matches(int code, const bool[] members, bool negated, string flags)
    return (members[code] or (flags.contains("i") and letter(code) and members[swap(code)])) != negated

bool assertion(string kind, const int[] subject, int position, string flags)
    if kind == "BOL"
        return position == 0 or (flags.contains("m") and subject[position - 1] == 10)
    if kind == "EOL"
        return position == int(#subject) or (flags.contains("m") and subject[position] == 10)
    left := position > 0 and word(subject[position - 1])
    right := position < int(#subject) and word(subject[position])
    return (left != right) == (kind == "WORD")

class Instruction(string kind, argument := 0, second := 0, mode := "", bool[] members := [], negated := false)

string text_character(int code)
    if code == 9
        return HT
    if code == 10
        return NL
    const printable := " !{DQ}#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{{|}}~"
    return printable[code - 32]

string character(int code)
    if 33 <= code <= 126 and code != 92 and code != 93 and code != 94 and code != 45
        return text_character(code)
    checked := nat8(code)
    hex := checked.B16
    return "\x" + "0" * (2 - #hex) + hex

string set_text(const bool[] members, negated := false)
    result := if negated then "[^" else "["
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < 128
        if not members[cursor]
            cursor += 1
            continue
        finish := cursor
        while finish + 1 < 128 and members[finish + 1]
            finish += 1
        result += character(cursor)
        if finish > cursor
            if finish - cursor >= 2
                result += "-"
            result += character(finish)
        cursor = finish + 1
    return result + "]"

string instruction_text(const Instruction entry)
    if entry.kind == "CHAR"
        return "CHAR " + character(entry.argument)
    if entry.kind == "CLASS"
        return "CLASS " + set_text(entry.members, entry.negated)
    if entry.kind == "SPLIT"
        return "SPLIT {entry.argument}, {entry.second}"
    if entry.kind == "JMP" or entry.kind == "SAVE" or entry.kind == "BACKREF"
        return "{entry.kind} {entry.argument}"
    if entry.kind == "ASSERT"
        return "ASSERT {entry.mode}"
    if entry.kind == "LOOK"
        return "LOOK {entry.mode} {entry.argument}"
    return entry.kind

string quote(const int[] codes)
    result := DQ
    for code := codes[]
        if code == 92
            result += "\\"
        elif code == 34
            result += "\" + DQ
        elif code == 10
            result += "\n"
        elif code == 9
            result += "\t"
        else
            result += text_character(code)
    return result + DQ

import chars = "./charset.qui"
import format = "./formatter.qui"
import backtrack = "./backtrack_vm.qui"
import pike = "./pike_vm.qui"

class Problem(string message, int column)
class Node(string kind, argument := 0, mode := "", int[] children := [], bool[] members := [], negated := false, lower := 0, upper := 0)
class GroupName(string name, int number)
class Reference(int node, int column)
class Parser(string text, cursor := 0, groups := 0, GroupName[] names := [], nodes := [Node("concat")], Reference[] references := [], Problem | none problem := none, failed := false)
class Bounds(int lower, int upper)
class ClassItem(int code, bool[] members, bool is_set)
class Pattern(string name, string flags, string text, int groups, GroupName[] names, Node[] nodes, int root, format.Instruction[] code, Problem | none problem, bool compatible)
class Properties(int lower, int upper, bool[] first, bool nullable)
class Part(code := -1, group := -1)
class Execution(int[][] matches, int backtrack_steps, int pike_steps, bool aborted, bool mismatch)

bool one_of(string text, int code)
    for candidate := text.codepoints()[]
        if candidate == code
            return true
    return false

int peek(const Parser parser)
    return if parser.cursor < int(#parser.text) then parser.text[parser.cursor].codepoints()[0] else -1

void fail(Parser &parser, string message, int position)
    if not parser.failed
        parser.failed = true
        parser.problem = Problem(message, position + 1)

int add_node(Parser &parser, Node node)
    parser.nodes = parser.nodes.append(node)
    return int(#parser.nodes) - 1

int group_number(const GroupName[] names, string name)
    for entry := names[]
        if entry.name == name
            return entry.number
    return -1

int digits(Parser &parser)
    start := parser.cursor
    while chars.digit(peek(parser))
        parser.cursor += 1
    return if parser.cursor == start then -1 else int(parser.text[start:<parser.cursor])

string read_name(Parser &parser)
    start := parser.cursor
    if chars.letter(peek(parser)) or peek(parser) == 95
        parser.cursor += 1
        while chars.word(peek(parser))
            parser.cursor += 1
    if parser.cursor == start or peek(parser) != 62
        fail(&parser, "invalid group name", parser.cursor)
        return ""
    name := parser.text[start:<parser.cursor]
    parser.cursor += 1
    return name

Bounds read_bounds(Parser &parser)
    start := parser.cursor
    parser.cursor += 1
    lower := digits(&parser)
    if lower == -1
        fail(&parser, "invalid quantifier", start)
        return Bounds(0, 0)
    upper := lower
    if peek(parser) == 44
        parser.cursor += 1
        upper = if peek(parser) == 125 then -1 else digits(&parser)
        if upper == -1 and peek(parser) != 125
            fail(&parser, "invalid quantifier", start)
    elif peek(parser) != 125
        fail(&parser, "invalid quantifier", start)
    if parser.failed or peek(parser) != 125
        fail(&parser, "invalid quantifier", start)
        return Bounds(0, 0)
    parser.cursor += 1
    if lower > 100 or upper > 100
        fail(&parser, "quantifier too large", start)
    elif upper >= 0 and lower > upper
        fail(&parser, "quantifier range out of order", start)
    return Bounds(lower, upper)

ClassItem class_item(Parser &parser)
    start := parser.cursor
    code := peek(parser)
    parser.cursor += 1
    members := chars.empty()
    if code != 92
        members[code] = true
        return ClassItem(code, members, false)
    code = peek(parser)
    if code == -1
        fail(&parser, "trailing backslash", start)
        return ClassItem(0, members, false)
    parser.cursor += 1
    if one_of("dDwWsS", code)
        return ClassItem(0, chars.base(code), true)
    if code == 110
        code = 10
    elif code == 116
        code = 9
    elif chars.letter(code) or chars.digit(code)
        fail(&parser, "invalid escape", start)
        return ClassItem(0, members, false)
    members[code] = true
    return ClassItem(code, members, false)

int character_class(Parser &parser)
    start := parser.cursor
    parser.cursor += 1
    negated := peek(parser) == 94
    if negated
        parser.cursor += 1
    if peek(parser) == 93
        fail(&parser, "empty class", parser.cursor)
        return 0
    members := chars.empty()
    while not parser.failed
        if peek(parser) == -1
            fail(&parser, "missing ]", start)
            break
        if peek(parser) == 93
            parser.cursor += 1
            break
        left := class_item(&parser)
        if parser.failed
            break
        if peek(parser) == 45 and parser.cursor + 1 < int(#parser.text) and parser.text[parser.cursor + 1] != "]"
            hyphen := parser.cursor
            parser.cursor += 1
            if left.is_set
                fail(&parser, "invalid range", hyphen)
                break
            right := class_item(&parser)
            if parser.failed
                break
            if right.is_set or left.code > right.code
                fail(&parser, "invalid range", hyphen)
                break
            for: left.code <= code <= right.code
                members[code] = true
        else
            for: code < 128
                members[code] = members[code] or left.members[code]
    return add_node(&parser, Node("class", members = members, negated = negated))

int escaped(Parser &parser)
    start := parser.cursor
    parser.cursor += 1
    code := peek(parser)
    if code == -1
        fail(&parser, "trailing backslash", start)
        return 0
    parser.cursor += 1
    if one_of("dDwWsS", code)
        negated := 65 <= code <= 90
        return add_node(&parser, Node("class", members = chars.base(if negated then code + 32 else code), negated = negated))
    if code == 98 or code == 66
        return add_node(&parser, Node("assert", mode = if code == 98 then "WORD" else "NOTWORD"))
    if code == 110 or code == 116
        return add_node(&parser, Node("literal", if code == 110 then 10 else 9))
    if 49 <= code <= 57
        parser.cursor -= 1
        number := digits(&parser)
        index := add_node(&parser, Node("backref", number))
        parser.references = parser.references.append(Reference(index, start))
        return index
    if code == 107
        if peek(parser) != 60
            fail(&parser, "invalid escape", start)
            return 0
        parser.cursor += 1
        name := read_name(&parser)
        index := add_node(&parser, Node("named", mode = name))
        parser.references = parser.references.append(Reference(index, start))
        return index
    if chars.letter(code) or chars.digit(code)
        fail(&parser, "invalid escape", start)
        return 0
    return add_node(&parser, Node("literal", code))

int alternation(Parser &parser);

int group(Parser &parser)
    start := parser.cursor
    parser.cursor += 1
    mode := "capture"
    named := ""
    if peek(parser) == 63
        parser.cursor += 1
        code := peek(parser)
        if code == 58
            mode = "plain"
        elif code == 61
            mode = "ahead"
        elif code == 33
            mode = "negative"
        elif code != 60
            fail(&parser, "invalid group", start)
            return 0
        parser.cursor += 1
        if code == 60
            name_start := parser.cursor
            named = read_name(&parser)
            if parser.failed
                return 0
            if group_number(parser.names, named) >= 0
                fail(&parser, "duplicate group name", name_start)
                return 0
    number := -1
    if mode == "capture"
        parser.groups += 1
        number = parser.groups
        if named != ""
            parser.names = parser.names.append(GroupName(named, number))
    content := alternation(&parser)
    if parser.failed
        return 0
    if peek(parser) != 41
        fail(&parser, "missing )", start)
        return 0
    parser.cursor += 1
    if number >= 0
        return add_node(&parser, Node("group", number, children = [content]))
    if mode == "plain"
        return content
    return add_node(&parser, Node("look", mode = if mode == "ahead" then "AHEAD" else "NOT", children = [content]))

int element(Parser &parser)
    code := peek(parser)
    if code == 40
        return group(&parser)
    if code == 91
        return character_class(&parser)
    if code == 92
        return escaped(&parser)
    parser.cursor += 1
    if code == 46
        return add_node(&parser, Node("any"))
    if code == 94 or code == 36
        return add_node(&parser, Node("assert", mode = if code == 94 then "BOL" else "EOL"))
    return add_node(&parser, Node("literal", code))

int quantified(Parser &parser)
    if one_of("*+?{{", peek(parser))
        fail(&parser, "nothing to repeat", parser.cursor)
        return 0
    index := element(&parser)
    if parser.failed or not one_of("*+?{{", peek(parser))
        return index
    if parser.nodes[index].kind == "assert" or parser.nodes[index].kind == "look"
        fail(&parser, "nothing to repeat", parser.cursor)
        return 0
    bounds := Bounds(0, -1)
    if peek(parser) == 123
        bounds = read_bounds(&parser)
    else
        code := peek(parser)
        parser.cursor += 1
        bounds = Bounds(if code == 43 then 1 else 0, if code == 63 then 1 else -1)
    if parser.failed
        return 0
    mode := "greedy"
    if peek(parser) == 63 or peek(parser) == 43
        mode = if peek(parser) == 63 then "lazy" else "possessive"
        parser.cursor += 1
    if one_of("*+?{{", peek(parser))
        fail(&parser, "nested quantifier", parser.cursor)
        return 0
    return add_node(&parser, Node("repeat", mode = mode, children = [index], lower = bounds.lower, upper = bounds.upper))

int concatenation(Parser &parser)
    int[] children := []
    while not parser.failed and peek(parser) != -1 and not one_of("|)", peek(parser))
        children = children.append(quantified(&parser))
    return if #children == 1 then children[0] else add_node(&parser, Node("concat", children = children))

int alternation(Parser &parser)
    children := [concatenation(&parser)]
    while not parser.failed and peek(parser) == 124
        parser.cursor += 1
        children = children.append(concatenation(&parser))
    return if #children == 1 then children[0] else add_node(&parser, Node("alternate", children = children))

void compile_node(const Node[] nodes, Node node, format.Instruction[] &code)
    if node.kind == "literal"
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("CHAR", node.argument))
    elif node.kind == "any"
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("ANY"))
    elif node.kind == "class"
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("CLASS", members = node.members, negated = node.negated))
    elif node.kind == "assert"
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("ASSERT", mode = node.mode))
    elif node.kind == "backref"
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("BACKREF", node.argument))
    elif node.kind == "group"
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("SAVE", 2 * node.argument))
        compile_node(nodes, nodes[node.children[0]], &code)
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("SAVE", 2 * node.argument + 1))
    elif node.kind == "look"
        start := int(#code)
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("LOOK", mode = node.mode))
        compile_node(nodes, nodes[node.children[0]], &code)
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("MATCH"))
        code[start].argument = int(#code)
    elif node.kind == "concat"
        for child := node.children[]
            compile_node(nodes, nodes[child], &code)
    elif node.kind == "alternate"
        int[] jumps := []
        for: index < int(#node.children) - 1
            split := int(#code)
            code = code.append(format.Instruction("SPLIT", split + 1))
            compile_node(nodes, nodes[node.children[index]], &code)
            jumps = jumps.append(int(#code))
            code = code.append(format.Instruction("JMP"))
            code[split].second = int(#code)
        compile_node(nodes, nodes[node.children[-1]], &code)
        for jump := jumps[]
            code[jump].argument = int(#code)
    elif node.mode == "possessive"
        start := int(#code)
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("LOOK", mode = "ATOMIC"))
        node.mode = "greedy"
        compile_node(nodes, node, &code)
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("MATCH"))
        code[start].argument = int(#code)
    else
        greedy := node.mode == "greedy"
        content := nodes[node.children[0]]
        if node.upper >= 0
            for: iteration < node.lower
                compile_node(nodes, content, &code)
            int[] splits := []
            for: iteration < node.upper - node.lower
                splits = splits.append(int(#code))
                code = code.append(format.Instruction("SPLIT"))
                compile_node(nodes, content, &code)
            finish := int(#code)
            for split := splits[]
                code[split] = format.Instruction("SPLIT", if greedy then split + 1 else finish, if greedy then finish else split + 1)
        elif node.lower == 0
            split := int(#code)
            code = code.append(format.Instruction("SPLIT"))
            compile_node(nodes, content, &code)
            code = code.append(format.Instruction("JMP", split))
            finish := int(#code)
            code[split] = format.Instruction("SPLIT", if greedy then split + 1 else finish, if greedy then finish else split + 1)
        else
            for: iteration < node.lower - 1
                compile_node(nodes, content, &code)
            start := int(#code)
            compile_node(nodes, content, &code)
            finish := int(#code) + 1
            code = code.append(format.Instruction("SPLIT", if greedy then start else finish, if greedy then finish else start))

Properties properties(const Node[] nodes, int index, string flags)
    node := nodes[index]
    first_set := chars.empty()
    if node.kind == "literal" or node.kind == "any" or node.kind == "class"
        for: character < 128
            if node.kind == "literal"
                first_set[character] = chars.equal(character, node.argument, flags)
            elif node.kind == "any"
                first_set[character] = flags.contains("s") or character != 10
            else
                first_set[character] = chars.class_matches(character, node.members, node.negated, flags)
        return Properties(1, 1, first_set, false)
    if node.kind == "assert" or node.kind == "look"
        return Properties(0, 0, first_set, true)
    if node.kind == "backref"
        return Properties(0, -1, array(128, fill = true), true)
    if node.kind == "group"
        return properties(nodes, node.children[0], flags)
    if node.kind == "repeat"
        child := properties(nodes, node.children[0], flags)
        upper := if child.upper == 0 then 0 elif child.upper == -1 or node.upper == -1 then -1 else node.upper * child.upper
        return Properties(child.lower * node.lower, upper, if node.upper == 0 then first_set else child.first, node.upper == 0 or child.nullable or node.lower == 0)
    alternating := node.kind == "alternate"
    lower := 0
    upper := 0
    nullable := not alternating
    first_child := true
    for child_index := node.children[]
        child := properties(nodes, child_index, flags)
        if alternating
            if first_child or child.lower < lower
                lower = child.lower
            upper = if upper == -1 or child.upper == -1 then -1 elif child.upper > upper then child.upper else upper
            nullable = nullable or child.nullable
        else
            lower += child.lower
            upper = if upper == -1 or child.upper == -1 then -1 else upper + child.upper
        if alternating or nullable
            for: character < 128
                first_set[character] = first_set[character] or child.first[character]
        if not alternating
            nullable = nullable and child.nullable
        first_child = false
    return Properties(lower, upper, first_set, nullable)

Pattern read_pattern(string line)
    fields := line.split(" ")
    text := fields[2:<int(#fields)].join(" ")
    parser := Parser(text)
    root := alternation(&parser)
    if not parser.failed and parser.cursor < int(#text)
        fail(&parser, "unmatched )", parser.cursor)
    if not parser.failed
        for reference := parser.references[]
            node := parser.nodes[reference.node]
            if node.kind == "backref"
                if node.argument > parser.groups
                    fail(&parser, "invalid group reference", reference.column)
                    break
            else
                number := group_number(parser.names, node.mode)
                if number < 0
                    fail(&parser, "unknown group name", reference.column)
                    break
                parser.nodes[reference.node].kind = "backref"
                parser.nodes[reference.node].argument = number
    format.Instruction[] code := []
    compatible := true
    if not parser.failed
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("SAVE", 0))
        compile_node(parser.nodes, parser.nodes[root], &code)
        code = code.append(format.Instruction("SAVE", 1)).append(format.Instruction("MATCH"))
        for entry := code[]
            if entry.kind == "BACKREF" or entry.kind == "LOOK"
                compatible = false
    return Pattern(fields[0], fields[1], text, parser.groups, parser.names, parser.nodes, root, code, parser.problem, compatible)

int[] decode(string quoted)
    int[] result := []
    cursor := 1
    while cursor + 1 < int(#quoted)
        int code := quoted[cursor].codepoints()[0]
        if code == 92
            cursor += 1
            code = quoted[cursor].codepoints()[0]
            code = if code == 110 then 10 elif code == 116 then 9 else code
        result = result.append(code)
        cursor += 1
    return result

Part[] | none read_template(const int[] codes, const Pattern pattern)
    Part[] parts := []
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#codes)
        code := codes[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        if code != 36
            parts = parts.append(Part(code))
            continue
        if cursor == int(#codes)
            return none
        if codes[cursor] == 36
            parts = parts.append(Part(36))
            cursor += 1
            continue
        number := -1
        if chars.digit(codes[cursor])
            number = codes[cursor] - 48
            cursor += 1
        elif codes[cursor] == 123
            cursor += 1
            start := cursor
            text := ""
            all_digits := true
            while cursor < int(#codes) and codes[cursor] != 125
                text += format.text_character(codes[cursor])
                all_digits = all_digits and chars.digit(codes[cursor])
                cursor += 1
            if cursor == int(#codes) or cursor == start
                return none
            cursor += 1
            number = if all_digits then int(text) else group_number(pattern.names, text)
        if number < 0 or number > pattern.groups
            return none
        parts = parts.append(Part(group = number))
    return parts

bool group_set(const int[] capture, int number)
    return capture[2 * number] >= 0 and capture[2 * number + 1] >= 0

int[] expand_template(const Part[] parts, const int[] capture, const int[] subject)
    int[] result := []
    for part := parts[]
        if part.group < 0
            result = result.append(part.code)
        elif group_set(capture, part.group)
            result = result.concat(subject[capture[2 * part.group]:<capture[2 * part.group + 1]])
    return result

Execution execute_command(const Pattern pattern, const int[] subject, string kind, bool first_only)
    full := kind == "MATCH"
    scanning := kind == "FINDALL" or kind == "SPLIT" or (kind == "REPLACE" and not first_only)
    backtrack_engine := backtrack.Engine(pattern.code, subject, pattern.flags, pattern.groups, full)
    int[][] backtrack_matches := []
    start := 0
    while start <= int(#subject)
        match backtrack.search(&backtrack_engine, start)
            int[] capture
                backtrack_matches = backtrack_matches.append(capture)
                start = if capture[1] > capture[0] then capture[1] else capture[1] + 1
            none
                break
        if not scanning or backtrack_engine.aborted
            break
    pike_engine := pike.Engine(pattern.code, subject, pattern.flags, pattern.groups, full)
    int[][] pike_matches := []
    if pattern.compatible
        start = 0
        while start <= int(#subject)
            match pike.search(&pike_engine, start)
                int[] capture
                    pike_matches = pike_matches.append(capture)
                    start = if capture[1] > capture[0] then capture[1] else capture[1] + 1
                none
                    break
            if not scanning
                break
    mismatch := pattern.compatible and not backtrack_engine.aborted and backtrack_matches != pike_matches
    return Execution(if pattern.compatible then pike_matches else backtrack_matches, backtrack_engine.steps, pike_engine.steps, backtrack_engine.aborted, mismatch)

string[] read_lines(string name)
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/{name}"))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

string span(const int[] capture, int number, const int[] subject)
    start := capture[2 * number]
    finish := capture[2 * number + 1]
    return "{start}-{finish} " + format.quote(subject[start:<finish])

string[] match_lines(const int[] capture, const int[] subject, int groups)
    lines := ["match " + span(capture, 0, subject)]
    for: 1 <= number <= groups
        lines = lines.append("group {number} " + (if group_set(capture, number) then span(capture, number, subject) else "-"))
    return lines

string[] program_lines(const Pattern pattern)
    information := properties(pattern.nodes, pattern.root, pattern.flags)
    string[] names := []
    for entry := pattern.names[]
        names = names.append("{entry.name}:{entry.number}")
    name_list := if #names == 0 then "-" else names.join(",")
    maximum := if information.upper < 0 then "inf" else "{information.upper}"
    has_first := false
    for member := information.first[]
        has_first = has_first or member
    first_set := if has_first then format.set_text(information.first) else "-"
    compatible := if pattern.compatible then "yes" else "no"
    lines := ["=== {pattern.name}", "flags={pattern.flags} groups={pattern.groups} names={name_list} length={information.lower}..{maximum} first={first_set} pike={compatible} size={#pattern.code}"]
    for: index < int(#pattern.code)
        lines = lines.append("{index} " + format.instruction_text(pattern.code[index]))
    return lines

string[] result_lines(const Pattern pattern, const int[] subject, string kind, const int[][] matches, const Part[] parts)
    string[] lines := []
    if kind == "MATCH" or kind == "SEARCH"
        return if #matches == 0 then ["no match"] else match_lines(matches[0], subject, pattern.groups)
    if kind == "FINDALL"
        lines = ["matches {#matches}"]
        for capture := matches[]
            lines = lines.concat(match_lines(capture, subject, pattern.groups))
        return lines
    cursor := 0
    if kind == "REPLACE"
        int[] text := []
        for capture := matches[]
            text = text.concat(subject[cursor:<capture[0]]).concat(expand_template(parts, capture, subject))
            cursor = capture[1]
        text = text.concat(subject[cursor:<int(#subject)])
        return ["replacements {#matches}", "result " + format.quote(text)]
    lines = ["pieces {int(#matches) + 1}"]
    for capture := matches[]
        lines = lines.append("piece " + format.quote(subject[cursor:<capture[0]]))
        for: 1 <= number <= pattern.groups
            text := if group_set(capture, number) then format.quote(subject[capture[2 * number]:<capture[2 * number + 1]]) else "-"
            lines = lines.append("group {number} {text}")
        cursor = capture[1]
    return lines.append("piece " + format.quote(subject[cursor:<int(#subject)]))

void write_lines(string name, const string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/{name}")
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

void run_program()
    map<string, Pattern> patterns
    map<string, int[]> subjects
    string[] errors := []
    for line := read_lines("patterns.txt")[]
        pattern := read_pattern(line)
        .patterns.set(pattern.name, pattern)
        match pattern.problem
            Problem problem
                errors = errors.append("{pattern.name}: {problem.message} at column {problem.column}")
                errors = errors.append("  " + pattern.text)
                errors = errors.append(" " * nat(problem.column + 1) + "^")
            none
                continue
    for line := read_lines("subjects.txt")[]
        fields := line.split(" ")
        .subjects.set(fields[0], decode(fields[1:<int(#fields)].join(" ")))
    string[] results := []
    string[] programs := []
    steps := ["command,engine,steps"]
    commands := read_lines("commands.txt")
    for: command_index < int(#commands)
        line := commands[command_index]
        fields := line.split(" ")
        kind := fields[0]
        replacing := kind == "REPLACE"
        pattern_name := fields[if replacing then 2 else 1]
        pattern := Pattern("", "", "", 0, [], [], 0, [], none, true)
        match patterns.get(pattern_name)
            Pattern found
                pattern = found
            none
                continue
        results = results.append("#{command_index + 1} {line}")
        invalid := false
        match pattern.problem
            Problem problem
                invalid = true
            none
                invalid = false
        if invalid
            results = results.append("invalid pattern")
            continue
        if kind == "LIST"
            results = results.append("instructions {#pattern.code}")
            programs = programs.concat(program_lines(pattern))
            continue
        int[] subject := []
        subject_name := fields[if replacing then 3 else 2]
        match subjects.get(subject_name)
            int[] found
                subject = found
            none
                continue
        Part[] parts := []
        if replacing
            template_codes := decode(fields[4:<int(#fields)].join(" "))
            match read_template(template_codes, pattern)
                Part[] found
                    parts = found
                none
                    results = results.append("invalid template")
                    continue
        first_only := replacing and fields[1] == "FIRST"
        execution := execute_command(pattern, subject, kind, first_only)
        steps = steps.append("{command_index + 1},backtrack,{execution.backtrack_steps}")
        if pattern.compatible
            steps = steps.append("{command_index + 1},pike,{execution.pike_steps}")
        if execution.mismatch
            results = results.append("MISMATCH")
        elif execution.aborted and not pattern.compatible
            results = results.append("TOO_MANY_STEPS")
        else
            engine := if pattern.compatible then (if execution.aborted then "pike (backtrack: TOO_MANY_STEPS)" else "both") else "backtrack"
            results = results.append("engine {engine}")
            results = results.concat(result_lines(pattern, subject, kind, execution.matches, parts))
    bool exists := file.exists("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    write_lines("results.txt", results)
    write_lines("programs.txt", if #programs == 0 then ["no programs"] else programs)
    write_lines("steps.csv", steps)
    write_lines("errors.txt", if #errors == 0 then ["no errors"] else errors)

if main
    run_program()

import chars = "./charset.qui"
import format = "./formatter.qui"

class Thread(int pc, int[] capture)
class Threads(Thread[] sequence, bool[] marks)
class Engine(format.Instruction[] code, int[] subject, string flags, int groups, bool full, steps := 0)

Threads new_list(int size)
    return Threads([], array(nat(size), fill = false))

bool consumes(const format.Instruction entry, const int[] subject, int position, string flags)
    if position == int(#subject)
        return false
    code := subject[position]
    if entry.kind == "CHAR"
        return chars.equal(code, entry.argument, flags)
    if entry.kind == "ANY"
        return flags.contains("s") or code != 10
    return chars.class_matches(code, entry.members, entry.negated, flags)

void add(Engine &engine, Threads &list, int pc, int[] capture, int position)
    if list.marks[pc]
        return
    list.marks[pc] = true
    engine.steps += 1
    entry := engine.code[pc]
    if entry.kind == "JMP"
        add(&engine, &list, entry.argument, capture, position)
    elif entry.kind == "SPLIT"
        add(&engine, &list, entry.argument, capture, position)
        add(&engine, &list, entry.second, capture, position)
    elif entry.kind == "SAVE"
        capture[entry.argument] = position
        add(&engine, &list, pc + 1, capture, position)
    elif entry.kind == "ASSERT"
        if chars.assertion(entry.mode, engine.subject, position, engine.flags)
            add(&engine, &list, pc + 1, capture, position)
    else
        list.sequence = list.sequence.append(Thread(pc, capture))

int[] | none search(Engine &engine, int start)
    int[] | none matched := none
    found_match := false
    list := new_list(int(#engine.code))
    position := start
    while true
        if not found_match and (not engine.full or position == start)
            add(&engine, &list, 0, array(nat(2 * engine.groups + 2), fill = -1), position)
        following := new_list(int(#engine.code))
        for thread := list.sequence[]
            engine.steps += 1
            entry := engine.code[thread.pc]
            if entry.kind == "MATCH"
                if not engine.full or position == int(#engine.subject)
                    matched = thread.capture
                    found_match = true
                    break
            elif consumes(entry, engine.subject, position, engine.flags)
                add(&engine, &following, thread.pc + 1, thread.capture, position + 1)
        if position == int(#engine.subject) or (#following.sequence == 0 and (found_match or engine.full))
            return matched
        list = following
        position += 1
